origin: Codex-assisted source-based selection, not human approval or an unbiased accuracy benchmark
selection_inputs: Canonical groups and original Slack messages, roles and reactions only; no hidden evaluation labels or previous Agent 2 outputs for selected cases.
common_criteria: Compare every member/message with its exact sources; do not confuse valid IDs with support.
Distinguish chosen resolution, its self-assessed confidence, specific unresolved scope and actual guidance; retain complete answers without forcing ambiguity OPEN.
Check original question scopes, conditions, tentative advice, TL authors and actual endorsing reaction users/targets; eyes is not approval.
Keep announcements as announcements and task categories separate from operational impact. Do not invent causal explanations, policy precedence, attempted workarounds or operational consequences.
Retain inherited, automatic and HIGH review obligations. Confirm complete research handoff including ANSWERED and failed-group sources.
Classify findings as supported, plausible with useful uncertainty, minor or consequential. Record specific model/automatic detection before review separately from post-review findings.
Readiness prioritizes uncontained consequential errors and repeated misleading patterns, not zero flags; no accuracy percentage.

cases.source_characteristics: One-member casual social exchange about a quieter room; non-operational content with no handling decision.
Recording/reference mismatch with local correspondence guidance endorsed by TL this; separate silence question has TL eyes acknowledgment.
Japanese forms and keigo shift; context-dependent scoring questions and TL request for beginning/ending forms; inherited disputes.
Vietnamese regional usage, conflicting locale assumptions, conditional TL guidance, tutor thumbs-up and unanswered acceptability questions.
Explicit submission blockage across disabled/click/loop symptoms, scoped TL confirmation rule and unknown engineering cause.
Quoted warnings/supportive content versus keyword-based classification, contextual TL-endorsed reply, separate diagnostic-only conversations and eyes acknowledgment.
Resource and deadline announcements, acknowledgments, null questions and differing operational relevance.
Requested-table omission, major/minor scoring question, TL instruction/factuality distinction; task categories independent of operational severity.
